beats.role_note: Film item: the game, the three assets and why the game needs each. Values verbatim from CHANGE-BRIEF.md A3-R0; images are the MCP look renders of the finished props (evidence/a3/mcp/).
beats.narration_text: Lanternfall is a two-dimensional survivors game set in a fog-bound night market. Bao picked three props from that market and froze their numbers before the build. A Lantern Gate for the entrance, two point eight five metres tall, which also blocks the player. A Supply Stack beside a stall. And a Lamp-oil Shrine near the upgrade area. Each has a size, an origin at the centre of its base, and a triangle budget.

beats.narration_text: The route. A community add-on, MCP for Blender, version two point one point nine, links Claude Code to Bao's running Blender through a socket on his own machine. The first status call answered straight away: add-on one point eight, telemetry off, and every model library and generator switched off. Earlier that day, a different coding session had no MCP tools at all, so the first builds were background scripts.

beats.role_note: Code beat (code-then-result-v1): godot/tests/test_a3_assets.gd lines 58-64 at c0dba4c, read verbatim; the next beat shows the result.
beats.narration_text: In Godot, one headless script loads each exported file and measures it. Line sixty-one takes the merged bounding box of every mesh, compares it with the brief within eleven millimetres, and requires the base at height zero. Line sixty-two requires every mesh node's scale to be one, and line sixty-three counts the parts and triangles against the budget.

props.title: Measuring the props in Godot.
props.source: godot/tests/test_a3_assets.gd · lines 58–64 · source revision c0dba4c · Godot editor reconstruction
props.code:
var measured := _measure(asset)
		var bounds: AABB = measured.bounds
		var id: String = spec.name.to_lower().replace(" ", "-")
		check(id + "-size-upright-origin", bounds.size.distance_to(spec.size) <= 0.011 and absf(bounds.position.y) <= 0.011, {"position": str(bounds.position), "size": str(bounds.size), "expected": str(spec.size)})
		check(id + "-unit-scale", measured.unit_scale, {"mesh_count": _meshes(asset).size()})
		check(id + "-shape-and-triangle-budget", _meshes(asset).size() <= spec.primitives and measured.triangles <= spec.triangles, {"primitives": _meshes(asset).size(), "primitive_budget": spec.primitives, "triangles": measured.triangles, "triangle_budget": spec.triangles})
		check(id + "-materials", measured.materials == spec.materials, {"materials": measured.materials})

cues.label: AABB size vs brief ≤ 0.011 m; base y ≤ 0.011 m

beats.narration_text: The gate also blocks. In Blender, two plain boxes carry the suffix convcolonly, so Godot imports them as collision with no picture. This script puts both bodies on physics layer three, the market-prop layer, and gives them no mask of their own.

props.title: Two boxes that only collide.
props.source: godot/a3/lantern_gate.gd · lines 1–11 · source revision c0dba4c · Godot editor reconstruction
props.code:
extends Node3D
## Applies the frozen A3 layer plan to the StaticBody3D nodes generated by
## Godot from Blender's `-convcolonly` meshes.

const PROP_LAYER := 3

func _ready() -> void:
	for body in find_children("*", "StaticBody3D", true, false):
		body.collision_layer = 0
		body.set_collision_layer_value(PROP_LAYER, true)
		body.collision_mask = 0

props.title: The camera Claude forgot.
props.source: godot/a3/lantern_gate_room.gd · lines 44–54 · source revision c0dba4c · Godot editor reconstruction
props.code:
func orbit(d_yaw: float, d_pitch: float, d_distance := 0.0) -> void:
	yaw = wrapf(yaw + d_yaw, -PI, PI)
	pitch = clampf(pitch + d_pitch, PITCH_MIN, PITCH_MAX)
	distance = clampf(distance + d_distance, DISTANCE_MIN, DISTANCE_MAX)
	_place_camera()

func _place_camera() -> void:
	camera.position = ORBIT_TARGET + Vector3(sin(yaw) * cos(pitch), sin(pitch), cos(yaw) * cos(pitch)) * distance
	camera.look_at(ORBIT_TARGET)
	# Below the floor's top only its picture is hidden; the floor collider stays.
	floor_mesh.visible = camera.position.y >= 0.0

beats.role_note: Film item: Bao's human check, what remains uncertain, what Claude got wrong, one next step. Bao's words verbatim; the English is labelled as Claude's translation.
beats.narration_text: Bao's own look at the final room. The front and back look normal. The lanterns and the gem draw yellower and the stack redder than in Blender, but the colours hang together, and he accepts that. From below he sees the overlapping circle under the stack, but only at very low angles, almost never from the game's view. The stand-in stops in front of the base and post and passes under the lantern arm. What else Claude got wrong: it first read the assignment as one prop, and one export call failed on its own check. Next: sit the barrel on the crate.

beats.role_note: Film item: human and AI contributions, and the source revision shown. From FRICTIONAL.md, SOURCES.md and the session logs.
beats.narration_text: Who did what. Bao chose the three props and the MCP route, approved every build plan, made the hand edit, took the interface screenshot, wrote the interface notes, and judged the room himself. Claude wrote and sent the twenty-seven build calls, wrote the Godot room and tests, and drafted the documents. This film shows source revision c zero d b a four c.

beats.role_note: ClaudeVerdictArtifact — implemented work, limitations, human judgment; shows the source revision.
beats.narration_text: The verdict. Implemented: three props built through the MCP from basic shapes, with every call kept, and their size, origin and scale confirmed in Godot. The gate blocks only where it should. The limits are a colour shift, overlapping faces under the barrel, and one hand edit. How they look is Bao's judgment.
